name: DeaDBeeF (Nightly)
description:
DeaDBeeF is a modular, lightweight audio player designed for GNU/Linux and Unix-like systems. Built with speed and responsiveness in mind, it provides bit-perfect playback and plays virtually every known audio format without heavy desktop dependencies.

Features:
- Supports MP3, FLAC, OGG, WAV, ALAC, AAC, APE, WMA, tracker modules, and chiptunes
- High-quality 18-band graphic equalizer and DSP plugin pipeline
- Advanced metadata tag editing and title formatting support
- Customizable user interface with tabbed playlists and customizable layout widgets
- Gapless playback, ReplayGain volume normalization, and global hotkeys
